item.title: Can Someone Please Tell Me I'm Wrong
item.author: ahmed@offsechq.com (A.Alghali)
item.description: I remember that particular day. I was heading to the University Of Khartoum. I took the city train. I was standing. there were no seats left. my head was facing the floor, and the train was moving. I was just there.
